subject: PoC / Trial plan and deployment mode follow-up — Acme Corp
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Thanks for the call — next steps & PoC options

Samantha —

Great to meet you and Mike on the call today. Quick recap from our side and recommended next steps so we can align on the right PoC approach: 

1) Deployment mode constraints you mentioned:
   - Security / compliance: likely need a Private VPC or Dedicated capacity for production due to PHI handling.
   - For initial evaluation, you asked whether a Hosted API PoC could validate performance and integration before committing to Dedicated or Private.

2) Key success criteria you mentioned on the call:
   - Avg generation latency under 200ms at target payloads
   - Throughput target: ~5k inference requests/day with bursts up to 2x
   - Quality: production prompts pass your internal accuracy checks (we'll define exact prompts)

3) Proposed next steps (short list):
   - We can run a 2-week Hosted API PoC to validate latency/quality quickly (no infra onboarding)
   - If results look good, move to a 4-6 week Dedicated pilot (reserved GPU pool) to validate sustained throughput and isolation
   - For Private VPC/on-prem, plan for an 8-12 week engagement (networking, security review, KMS integration)

I attached a short PoC proposal and a one-page checklist with roles and timelines. Can you confirm:
   - Which PoC path you'd like to start with (Hosted quick-eval vs start with Dedicated pilot)?
   - Who are the internal stakeholders we should loop in for the security/infra review (CISO, infra lead, procurement contact)?

Proposed kickoff windows:
   - Hosted PoC: week of Jul 12 (2 weeks)
   - Dedicated pilot: target Jul 26 start (4-6 weeks)

I'll have Ben (cc'd) join the technical kickoff if you pick Dedicated or Private so we can scope resource needs.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-poc-proposal.pdf

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Todd <mike.todd@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the call — next steps & PoC options

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few points from our side:

- Security: our CISO (Neela Patel) will require an initial security questionnaire and may want to see SOC2 evidence before any Dedicated/Private deployment. For evaluation only, we're open to a Hosted PoC provided data is obfuscated (we can send sample pseudo-data).
- Stakeholders to loop in: Neela Patel (CISO), Rajiv Menon (VP Infrastructure), Carmen Ruiz (Procurement).
- Success criteria (we want these explicitly in the PoC acceptance):
   1) 95th percentile latency < 250ms for the promot types we shared (50 tokens avg)
   2) Sustained throughput of 5k req/day with no errors for 48-hour window
   3) Sample prompt accuracy: pass our labeled test set at >= 92% precision (we will share test set)

We'd like to start with the Hosted PoC the week of Jul 12 to validate integration and quality quickly. If that looks good from a controls and performance perspective, we will move to a Dedicated pilot while the security review for Private/VPC runs.

Please send an updated PoC plan that includes: exact test harness, responsibilities (who runs tests vs who validates results), timeline, and estimated costs. Also include any compliance artifacts we can start reviewing.

Thanks,
Samantha
Director, Product Management — AI, Acme Corp

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-07-03T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the call — next steps & PoC options

Samantha — thanks — very helpful. Attached is an updated PoC plan that maps to the acceptance criteria you listed and lays out responsibilities. Highlights below: 

PoC approach (Hosted API — 2 weeks)
- Objective: validate integration, latency/quality at sample scale, and run labeled test set provided by Acme.
- Redwood will provide:
  * Dedicated SE for integration (Ben) and a Solutions Engineer to help run load tests
  * Temporary scoped API keys and an ingestion endpoint with prefix caching enabled
  * A short test harness (script + JMeter profile) to reproduce request patterns (we'll share Git link)
- Acme will provide:
  * Labeled test set (we agreed you'll share by Jul 8)
  * Sample obfuscated payloads for initial runs
  * Decision owner for acceptance (Neela for security sign-off, Rajiv for infra/perf)

Success criteria (explicit):
1) 95th percentile latency < 250ms for the test set at nominal load
2) No more than 1% error rate during a sustained 48-hour run at 5k req/day
3) Labeled test-set precision >= 92%

Timeline & milestones:
- Jul 8: Acme shares test set and obfuscated payloads
- Jul 12: Kickoff + initial integration (Ben + SE on call)
- Jul 13-16: Run integration & small-scale tests (collect baseline)
- Jul 19-20: 48-hour sustained run and labeled test evaluation
- Jul 21: PoC results review and recommendation (success / next steps)

Costs: Hosted PoC is covered under the trial credit (no invoice). Dedicated pilot and Private VPC estimates included in appendix of attached PDF.

Security artifacts: I'll share a SOC2 summary and our standard security questionnaire link. Carmen — happy to route procurement questions and SOW once we confirm PoC kickoff.

Next steps: can you confirm Jul 12 kickoff and that the test set will be delivered by Jul 8? If yes, we'll send a calendar invite and the kickoff agenda.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-poc-proposal.pdf, redwood-poc-success-metrics.xlsx
Related: https://docs.redwood.com/poc-templates/acme-poc-checklist

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Todd <mike.todd@acmecorp.com>, Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-07-07T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks for the call — next steps & PoC options

Jordan —

Confirmed. We will:
- Deliver the obfuscated test set by EOD Jul 8.
- Internal approval obtained to run Hosted PoC first.
- Neela (CISO) will start the security questionnaire; Carmen from procurement will follow up on SOW/PO after PoC success.

Please send the kickoff invite for Jul 12 (10:00am PT) and include Ben for the technical walkthrough. Also send a link to the security questionnaire and any SOC2 evidence you referenced.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Samantha Lee
Director, Product Management — AI, Acme Corp
